description: National Database for Emergency Management (NDEM) is a database run by National Remote Sensing Centre for the National Disaster Management Authority, India. NDEM is a geospatial decision-support platform for disaster management that holds hazard, vulnerability and infrastructure layers such as roads, bridges, hospitals and shelters for Indian states, with near-real-time flood and cyclone monitoring. Coverage: India. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as viewer, wms; access is restricted to government users for many layers, public viewer for some. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("National Database of Emergency Managment") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support emergency management and hazard exposure studies of India. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
